user.title: Connect My Secret Garden
user.description: Enter the address of your My Secret Garden server and an API key. Create the key in the app under Settings → API keys.

data_description.api_url: Address reachable from Home Assistant, including the port (e.g. http://192.168.1.50:8000).

reauth_confirm.title: New API key required
reauth_confirm.description: The server {url} rejected the current API key. Create a new one in the app under Settings → API keys.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the server. Check the address and port.
error.invalid_auth: The server rejected the API key.

abort.reauth_successful: API key updated, the integration is reloading.
